name: Raid.Earth
author: RamiroRP
tag_line: Real rallies, raids and Dakar stages on BeamNG.Earth
description: Raid.Earth turns BeamNG.Earth into a rally simulator: drive the real special stages of real events (imported from KML/KMZ/GPX/GeoJSON) with time controls, start and finish lines, stop control, radio and medical points, spectators, safety barriers, the vanilla rally signs and a co-driver that calls the pacenotes (a Spanish co-driver voice is included). Single stages or full rallies with time card, liaisons and penalties. Requires BeamNG.Earth. Open it from Esc > Raid.Earth. Only active on BeamNG.Earth maps: it does not change the vanilla rally mode.
